missing_information_behavior: Do not present curcumin as an established treatment; clarify diagnosis, medicines, formulation and intended outcome.
safety_exclusions: Do not claim to cure arthritis or replace prescribed treatment.
Do not generalize evidence across turmeric powders, extracts and bioavailability-enhanced formulations.
Do not overlook anticoagulant/antiplatelet medicines or gallbladder disease.
professional_escalation_conditions: Persistent or worsening joint pain, swelling/redness/fever, anticoagulant use, gallstones/bile duct disease, liver injury symptoms or planned surgery.
population_and_context: People with joint discomfort considering curcumin/turmeric products; evidence in knee osteoarthritis is promising but heterogeneous and not definitive.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Formulations vary markedly; do not transfer doses from one extract to another.
certainty_and_limitations: NCCIH turmeric resources describe uncertainty and formulation-specific evidence; source passages and safety interactions require appraisal. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
